_doc: Ledger of the Eden port. One entry per module of docs/eden-port/DESIGN.md section 3, in port order. status: todo | porting | verify | done | blocked. Only the orchestrator (skill eden-port) changes status; every change is committed together with the work it records. `upstream_tests` are the files of .upstream/tests/integration whose [test] functions the Eden test file must cover (scripts/eden/coverage.py); `eden_tests` is that file under tests/eden/.
goal: every module done, scripts/eden/gate.sh green, scripts/eden/spec.sh and scripts/eden/wasi.sh --fast green

modules.name: m3_exception
modules.note: declares nothing (a public re-export of m3_config, as m3_exception.h is macros only); the header's macro expansion table is the contract, the Eden test exercises each expansion shape; no upstream test file

modules.name: m3_exec_defs
modules.note: no upstream test file; the Eden file tests the slot/memory/immediate accessors of DESIGN 4.2-4.4 directly

modules.name: m3_api_defs
modules.note: no upstream test file; the Eden tests link raw functions built with the helpers and call them from wasm

modules.name: lang_modules
modules.note: end-to-end: every wasm3c/test/lang fixture through the whole stack, fib(25)=75025; the fib32 regression is folded in

modules.name: app
modules.note: .local/app/wasm3_eden.das (REPL for run-spec-test.py / run-wasi-test.py, from .upstream/app/wasm3.das) and the wasm3_run cheat of .eden_host/main.das; done when scripts/eden/spec.sh and scripts/eden/wasi.sh --fast are green. test_spec_core / test_spec_modules_load of the upstream suite are replaced by spec.sh (they need the corpus on disk)
